content: BLUEPRINT Elements in such a package act as a kind of blueprint for real objects. 41 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 This applies in particular to objects such as PortInterface which are not mod- eled particularly to be a blueprint but still are specializations of AtpBlueprint respectively AtpBlueprintable .
